inventory_summary: 174 base runs, 46 door casings, 4 landing base runs, stair skirts, 7 trim stock products inspected from the resolved model; A-603, A-002, A-516..530 text-searched. Main defects: set is silent on interior trim, A-603 Base column empty, MDF thickness, shiplap-offset base proud of casing.
verified_clean: Reveal: inner edge = RO/2 - 13/16 -> 3/16" reveal to a 1" jamb+shim allowance, inside the 3/16-1/4" norm (interior_trim_scope.casing_edges).
Casing head bottom = RO head - 13/16" for all 28 doors with a plain RO (probe p9).
Casing/base size 3/4 x 3-1/2 matches pine FJ, PVC (AZEK 1x4) actual sizes; poplar 1x12 = 11-1/4".
Base and casing never overlap in plan (probe p3); head stays within its legs on all 45 headed casings.
Legs start at finished floor of the room; base z0 = finished floor on tile/LVP/oak/concrete; landing base at landing floor z=1.555.
Hardwood casing/base cut list (millwork.md) packs 8' boards and flags the spliced locust base run.
Stair skirt board 11-1/4" x 3/4" gives >5" above the nosing line.

findings.title: A-603 room finish schedule prints '—' in the Base (and Walls) column for all 36 rooms although 174 base runs are derived

evidence.measured: Base column is '—' for every room; model.base_runs has 174 runs (pine-fj-base, pvc-trim, locust-trim, vinyl cove, resilient). Walls column also '—' in every room.
evidence.expected: Base column states the derived base stock/height per room (e.g. pine-fj-base 3-1/2" x 3/4"), or 'by floor' for tile/vinyl cove.
evidence.method: pdftotext -f 135 -l 135 -layout houses/catlin/out/geometry-review-2026-10-31/baseline/permit_set_full.pdf (A-603); code: _finish(room,'base_finish') reads an unauthored Room field, not model.base_runs.

findings.source: emit/draw/schedules/openings.py docstring claims 'every column is DERIVED'; decision #85
findings.proposed_fix: Derive Base from model.base_runs per room (material name, height, kind) and Walls from room-face finish layer; add casing stock/width line.

findings.title: No sheet in the set specifies interior casing or base: no stock, width, reveal, jamb allowance or milled-vs-bought

evidence.measured: grep casing/baseboard/skirt/reveal over all 158 pages: only A-603 'Base' header, cladding trim and connector base posts. A-002 has no trim spec. 46 casings / 174 base runs are in the BOM only.
evidence.expected: A-002 (or an interior-trim detail) states 3/4x3-1/2 casing, 3/16 reveal, 13/16 inside RO, 3-1/2 base, stock by room, scribe rule, 2-1/4/1-1/2 one-offs.
evidence.method: for i in 1..158: pdftotext -f i -l i -layout permit_set_full.pdf - | grep -i 'casing\|baseboard\|skirt\|reveal'

findings.proposed_fix: Add an interior-trim spec block to A-002 generated from TrimStandard and its Room/DoorTrim overrides.

findings.title: MDF 1x4 casing modelled 3/4" thick; retail primed MDF 1x4 is 11/16" (0.669")

evidence.measured: All 46 casings (mostly mdf-casing) and all base share TrimStandard.thickness = 0.75"; product model string says '3/4" x 3 1/2" S4S'.
evidence.expected: Primed MDF 1x4: 11/16" (HD 0.669"x3.5"; Lowes 21/32"). A 3/4" MDF exists only as a Kent.ca special item. Casing 1/16" thinner than the 3/4" pine/PVC base: base ends stand 1/16" proud.
evidence.method: WebSearch 'primed MDF board 1x4 actual thickness'; python: {c.material_ref:c.thickness_m*39.37 for c in model.door_casings}

findings.proposed_fix: Correct the MDF product/material wording to 11/16" and let casing thickness follow the stock (or specify 3/4" MDF source); expect base-proud note on spec.

findings.title: Mudroom base stands 3/4" proud of its door casing: shiplap-backed base offset 0.75" while casing sits on the drywall plane flush with the shiplap face

evidence.measured: W-M-MECH-S: casing leg 2.25-3.0" from axis, base 3.0-3.75" (offset 0.75"), shiplap 2.25..3.0 abutting the legs (0.0" gap). Base ends at casing outer edge 3/4" proud of it. 7 PVC runs offset 0.75"; D-M-ENTRY leg_right also overlaps shiplap by 3.6 cm2.
evidence.expected: Base no thicker than casing at the meeting (casing over the shiplap, or a plinth block), casing not sharing volume with shiplap.
evidence.method: scratchpad/geometry-review/O2/p5.py, p6.py, p13.py in scratchpad: wall-axis distances of casing legs vs base vs WP-M-MUDROOM-SHIPLAP pieces

findings.proposed_fix: Offset the casing by the band thickness on banded walls (casing sits on the band) or end the band at the jamb.

findings.title: D-M-BATH2 bathroom face: both casing legs dropped, leaving a floating 3-1/2" head with no legs

evidence.measured: pieces=[head 34.1"]; clips: leg_left vs FX-M-BATH2-SINK 0.94" left, leg_right vs FX-M-BATH2-SH 0.56" left (min_leg_width 1.5"). BOM bills head only.
evidence.expected: Either a full narrow casing (DoorTrim casing_width like BATH1) or drywall-return/no casing; a head with no legs is not buildable trim.

findings.proposed_fix: Add D-M-BATH2 to uncased_doors, or drop the head when both legs drop.

findings.title: Engine drops a head when both legs drop; and scribed legs of 1.58-2.94" leave unequal reveals-to-wall that the set never states

evidence.measured: Scribed legs: HALVES-R 1.58, ENTRY-L 2.19, BATH1-L 2.56, BED2-R 2.94, SUITE 2.44/2.45, POCKET-R 3.33; head full-width stays within legs hull (checked, frac 0).
evidence.expected: Acceptable carpentry; head correctly follows legs. Recorded for the trade as site scribe.

findings.title: Base on carpet rooms is modelled sitting on the carpet surface, contradicting 'carpet tucks under it'

evidence.measured: Base z0 = room_finished_floor_elevation for carpet / catlin-carpet-raised (29 runs, floor build-up 0.5"/1.5" above structure).
evidence.expected: Base bottom ~1/2" above the sub-floor/pad with carpet tucked under; base top then 4" above carpet or base 3.5" from pad.

findings.proposed_fix: Start carpet-room base at the pad/subfloor plane (+1/2") rather than carpet top.

findings.title: Devices within 1/4" of casing legs: ED-M-LIVING-RC10 0.08", ED-M-BATH1-SW 0.20", ED-M-CLOSET-SW 0.31", ED-S-PLANT-SW-TIMER 0.31", ED-S-NCLOSET-SW 0.33"

evidence.measured: Footprint-to-casing distance 0.076-0.33" (check only flags overlap > 1e-6 m2).
evidence.expected: Plate edge >= ~1/4" off casing for a cut-in box and painter caulk.
evidence.method: scratchpad/geometry-review/O2/p8.py (distance of wall-hosted canvas_objects to casing prisms, z-overlapped)

findings.proposed_fix: Leave to M3; optionally add a clearance band to trim_device_clash.

findings.title: Devices overlapping D-A-POCKET casing (already UNKNOWN) - ED-A-POCKET-SW and ED-A-STUDIO-AP straddle leg and head

evidence.measured: Distance 0.0 to leg_left (both) and head (POCKET-SW); two UNKNOWN in checks.json.
evidence.expected: Devices clear of casing or casing scribed.

findings.title: ST-M2S skirt blank is 103.5" long, longer than the 8' stock assumed for trim; no stock-length or splice stated

evidence.measured: Blank cut lengths 103.5" and 92.1"; TrimStandard.stock_length = 8'; poplar 1x12 has no product_ref.
evidence.expected: 10' or 12' 1x12 poplar for the 103.5" board (11-1/4" actual width is correct).

findings.proposed_fix: Note 10' stock in the material source / add product row.

findings.title: Base-to-casing gap of 0.3" at D-S-SUITE where legs are scribed

evidence.measured: Only 2 of 69 base/casing meetings do not butt (0.299", 0.313"); rest 0.0".
